item.title: Full SNAP benefits restored to Minnesotans after Attorney General Ellison sues
item.description:
Publication Date: November 08, 2025

Benefits should be available as early as today for 440K Minnesotans as part of nationwide restoration for 42M Americans

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/11/08_SNAP.asp

item.title: Court stays Trump Administration demand that states ‘undo’ release of full SNAP benefits after Attorney General Ellison intervenes
item.description:
Publication Date: November 10, 2025

Court responds early this morning to motion AG Ellison and coalition filed late last night, in which they argued court should block Trump Administration threat to punish states financially for following a court order and USDA’s guidance, which USDA later went back on

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2025/11/10_SNAP.asp
